new_value: Fixed: L2 TX now uses the 4.1.0 async API. lora_l2_tx.c arms lora_send_async(dev, tx_buf, len, &tx_done_signal) (static k_poll_signal, reset immediately before each arm) and waits via k_poll(K_FOREVER, thread context asserted with __ASSERT_NO_MSG(!k_is_in_isr())); the poll-signal result becomes the return status fed into CSMA tx_complete and duty-cycle recording exactly as the old blocking lora_send() result was; public signature and synchronous contract preserved; tx_buf zeroing still after completion. Driver prerequisite fixed too: the four send_async implementations were sync-delegating stubs that IGNORED the poll signal (a wait would have hung forever) - lora_sim.c, lora_renode.c, lr1110.c now k_poll_signal_raise(async, ret) with the underlying send's result, and lora_loopback.c gained a previously-missing send_async (test driver for ping_l2). VERIFIED on heft: ping_l2 builds and runs identically to the pre-port baseline (4/7 pass; the 3 failures are 5fva children's frame-build-layer issues that never reach the radio TX - unchanged symptom -126 at frame build). Review: pass 1+2 PASS (reset-before-arm ordering prevents stale signals; no deadlock - driver completion never takes L2 mutexes; CSMA/duty-cycle get the final status; zeroing after completion; 4.1.0 poll semantics correct), pass 3 PASS (tx_buf_mutex spans reset+arm+wait so no cross-caller signal pairing; stop() race pre-existing; no stale raise) with the K_FOREVER wedge-shape note deferring to the existing cdoj tracking (bead-prescribed K_FOREVER retained).
